analysis_notes: Exploratory study-block holdout analysis assembled after screening the cited source tables.
The reference labels are identifiers from Su et al. Table S2; the source crosswalk is documented in data/asv/README.md.
The 12 Alchouron compiled response values are replaced by thesis-figure means; the Sun compiled rows are replaced by 30 species-resolved As(V) figure means.

The released 138-row analysis input is data/asv/analysis_input.csv; its study-block screening, figure digitization, units, and grouping limitations are documented in data/asv/README.md and the manuscript Supporting Information Text S7.
This branch is separate from the primary IBU, Sr, and Cd analyses and is not independent prospective validation.
